title: Binance Adds Gravity (G) on Earn, Buy Crypto, Convert, & Margin
text: This is a general announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region.  Fellow Binancians, Binance is excited to announce that  Gravity (G)  has been added to  Binance Simple Earn ,  "Buy Crypto" , and  Binance Convert . In addition, Binance will add  G  on  Binance Margin  and  Binance Auto-Invest  at  2024-07-19 10:00 (UTC)  and  2024-07-22 10:00 (UTC)  respectively.  Earn Users can now subscribe to  G Flexible Products  on Binance Simple Earn. From  2024-07-22 at 10:00 (UTC) , users may purchase G using any of the payment options supported on  Binance Auto-Invest . Buy & Sell Crypto Users may now buy G directly with their  credit/debit cards, Google Pay, Apple Pay , or buy and sell G directly with their available  wallet balances  at the “ Buy Crypto ” page. Convert Users can now trade G against BTC, USDT, and any other tokens supported by  Binance Convert  at  zero fees .  Margin Binance Margin will add  G  as a new borrowable asset on Cross and Isolated Margin, as well as the  G/USDT  pair on Cross and Isolated Margin at  2024-07-19 10:00 (UTC) . Please refer to  Margin Data  for a list of the most updated marginable assets and further information on specific limits, collateral ratio and rates.
